units.source_text: 经过这场争执，约莫一个小时之后。

en.t: About an hour after this quarrel had ended.

units.source_text: 很久没来店铺的鱼贩德藏。

en.t: There was Tokuzo the fishmonger, who had not come to the shop in a long time.

units.source_text: 不，他如今是鱼贩了。

en.t: No, he is a fishmonger now.

units.source_text: 他过去曾是个鱼贩，如今是个人力车夫，是经常来家里走动的年轻人。

en.t: He had once been a fishmonger, but now he was a rickshaw man, a young fellow who often came in and out of the house.

units.source_text: 这个德藏闹过很多笑话。

en.t: This Tokuzo had been the cause of many comic stories.

units.source_text: 其中我记得比较清楚的是有关姓氏的笑话。

en.t: The one I remember most clearly among them was a joke about surnames.

units.source_text: 德藏也是在明治维新之后才取的姓氏，

en.t: Tokuzo, too, only took a surname after the Meiji Restoration,

units.source_text: 那时候他可能觉得既然要取个姓氏，

en.t: and at the time he must have thought that if he was going to take a surname,

units.source_text: 当然要取个非常高端的，

en.t: of course it ought to be a very grand one,

units.source_text: 于是他自取“德川”作为姓氏。

en.t: and so he chose Tokugawa as his surname.

units.source_text: 不过，他去政务所登记的时候，

en.t: However, when he went to the government office to register it,

units.source_text: 被办事员骂的狗血淋头。

en.t: the clerk gave him a terrible scolding.

units.source_text: 按照德藏自己的说法，

en.t: According to Tokuzo himself,

units.source_text: 当时办事员愤怒的程度就跟要把他拖出去问斩一般。

en.t: the clerk was so angry that it seemed as if he meant to drag him out and behead him.

units.source_text: 话说那天，德藏拉着自己的人力车——车上画着牡丹和唐朝狮子，

en.t: Now, on that day, Tokuzo came pulling his own rickshaw, which was painted with peonies and Chinese lions,

units.source_text: 轻松愉快的 来到店里。

en.t: and arrived at the shop in a carefree, cheerful mood.

units.source_text: 本来以为他有什么大事才过来的，

en.t: I had assumed he must have come because something important had happened,

units.source_text: 没想到他说：

en.t: but unexpectedly he said:

units.source_text: “今天没什么客人，

en.t: There are not many customers today,

units.source_text: 所以想拉着小姐到津原附近的砖屋大街上去逛逛。”

en.t: so I thought I would take the young lady for a ride to Brick Shop Street near Tsuhara.
